gates.name: judge_facts
gates.detail: factual risk 3/10: Spending $5 on coffee today doesn't cost $5. It costs you $226,000. (Mathematically incorrect. A single $5 purchase today does not compound to $226k; it requires a recurring $5 daily investment for 30 years.); It's simple math your bank hopes you never calculate. (Sensationalist; banks do not care about this calculation, and many offer investment services that promote this exact math.)
